# Lunia

> Lunia is Saudi Arabia's first Skin Quality Center, based in Riyadh. It follows a
> non-injectable, Korean-inspired philosophy: build healthy skin from the inside out
> through diagnostic-first, layered treatment rather than masking concerns with a
> single procedure. Lunia's own positioning is direct: "Not facials — skin quality."

## What Lunia is

- A skin quality clinic in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia — not a medspa focused on injectables,
  and not a facial bar offering one-off pampering treatments.
- Every client visit begins with a diagnostic skin analysis; treatment plans are matched
  to real skin needs and adjusted over time to improve texture, hydration, and resilience.
- Non-injectable: Lunia does not offer Botox, fillers, or other injectable procedures.

## Departments

- Skin Quality — diagnostic-first facials and resurfacing treatments for texture,
  hydration, and long-term skin health.
- Hair & Scalp — scalp is treated as an extension of skin; scalp health treatments
  that extend in-clinic results with at-home care.
- Post-Surgery Care — recovery-focused skin support after surgical procedures.

## Brands carried

- ZO Skin Health — clinically backed, physician-grade skincare.
- PCA — versatile, well-tolerated peel systems.
- Image Skincare — accessible, effective formulations for a wide range of skin types.
- EltaMD — daily sun protection after in-clinic treatments.
- 72 Hair — at-home scalp care aligned with the "scalp as skin" philosophy.

## Contact

Lunia is located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. For appointments and inquiries, use the
contact page (/en/contact or /ar/contact) or WhatsApp linked from the site header.
The site is bilingual, Arabic (default, RTL) and English.
